name: Groonsword
body:
This heavy, oversized greatsword is difficult to wield, but powerful in its strikes.

Weapon Groups: Heavy blade

Type: Exotic, two-handed slashing.

Damage: 3d6

Crit: 19-20×2

Range: –

Weight: 25 lbs.

Special: If your Strength is less than 19 (or 17 for a Small or smaller groonsword), you take a –2 penalty on attacks with it, as you’re unable to maneuver its daunting size and weight.

The Book of many Things Volume 2: Shattered Worlds. © 2018, Samurai Sheepdog; Author: Kevin Glusing.
